title: Create a project with the wizard
description: Use when creating a project through a three-page New Project wizard: name it, pick a template, review and create.
overview: A wizard dialog sequence with field typing, a template choice, and a summary page.

source.title: Create a project with the wizard

steps.actions: On page 1 of the wizard type demo-site into Name and click Next.
On page 2 select Static site and click Next.
steps.success_criteria: Static site is the checked template.

steps.actions: On page 3 review the summary and click Create.
steps.success_criteria: The wizard closes and the status bar reads Project demo-site created.

evidence.quote: Review the summary and click Create
